methods:
Executed methods (only successfully completed operations are described):

S1 · Trim reads with fastp was performed using fastp 1.3.7-reportfix1; paircheck 1.0.1 (pack fastp 0.4.1). Trim known adapters and paired-read overlaps; sliding-window tail trimming with explicit quality/length/N filters. Poly-G trimming and duplicate estimation are disabled. Orphans and failures are retained. Settings: Trimming / alignment workers=2; Read 1 3' adapter=AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA; Read 2 3' adapter=AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT; Tail-window mean quality=20; Tail-window size=4; Minimum retained read length=35; Qualified base Phred score=15; Maximum low-quality bases (%)=40; Maximum N bases per read=5. Inputs: Paired reads: I1 · Example paired reads.

S2 · Align reads with BWA was performed using bwa 0.7.19-r1273; paircheck 1.0.1; samtools 1.24 (pack bwa 0.4.0). Align paired short reads, with explicit read groups, streaming directly to BAM. Settings: Sample name (SM)=truth; Read group ID=truth-lane-1; Library ID (LB)=truth-library; Platform unit (PU)=truth-unit; Sequencing platform (PL)=ILLUMINA; Trimming / alignment workers=2. Inputs: Paired reads: S1 · Trim reads with fastp → Trimmed paired reads | Reference genome: I2 · Example reference.

S3 · Prepare aligned reads was performed using samtools 1.24 (pack bam 0.4.0). Name-sort, fix mates, coordinate-sort, mark duplicates, index and summarize. Duplicates are retained. Inputs: Paired alignments: S2 · Align reads with BWA → Unsorted alignment BAM.

S4 · BCFtools variant calls was performed using bcftools 1.24; samtools 1.24 (pack variants 0.4.0). Sample identities come from BAM read groups. Selected ploidy applies to all contigs and samples; LowQual is a site-level filter. Settings: Assumed ploidy=2; Minimum mapping quality=20; Minimum base quality=20; Maximum pileup depth per file=1000; Variant quality threshold=20; Sample depth threshold=5. Inputs: Prepared BAM: S3 · Prepare aligned reads → Sorted, duplicate-marked BAM | Reference genome: I2 · Example reference.

S5 · FreeBayes variant calls was performed using bcftools 1.24; freebayes 1.3.10; samtools 1.24 (pack freebayes 0.4.0). Call SNPs and indels from a prepared BAM, normalize, soft-filter and index. Sample names come from BAM read groups. Settings: Assumed ploidy=2; Minimum mapping quality=20; Minimum base quality=20; Variant quality threshold=20; Sample depth threshold=5; Minimum alternate observations=2; Minimum alternate allele fraction=0.2. Inputs: Prepared coordinate-sorted BAM: S3 · Prepare aligned reads → Sorted, duplicate-marked BAM | Reference genome: I2 · Example reference.

S6 · BCFtools call statistics was performed using bcftools 1.24 (pack variants 0.4.0). Summarize an existing VCF or BCF. Inputs: Variants: S4 · BCFtools variant calls → All normalized calls with filter labels.

S7 · FreeBayes call statistics was performed using bcftools 1.24 (pack variants 0.4.0). Summarize an existing VCF or BCF. Inputs: Variants: S5 · FreeBayes variant calls → All normalized calls with filter labels.

S8 · Quality and caller reports was performed using Combine statistics reports (pack builtin 0.5.0). Collect selected statistics into a local HTML report with a separate, attributed section for each input. Counts are not pooled and variant files are not merged. Settings: Report title=Example reads: two callers, separately reported. Inputs: Statistics to include: S1 · Trim reads with fastp → fastp metrics (JSON); S3 · Prepare aligned reads → Alignment statistics; S6 · BCFtools call statistics → Variant statistics; S7 · FreeBayes call statistics → Variant statistics.

Operations run locally in dependency order. Independent branches are scheduled sequentially. The run record records exact packs, parameters, input identities, outputs and completion states.

validation_environment.backend: PortableBackend test adapter; not the Windows WorkbenchBridge backend
validation_environment.execution: Installed pack manifests with real SHA256-verified APE executables through bundled ape-loader-linux
validation_environment.truth_comparison: BCFtools and FreeBayes each exactly matched all four expected variant alleles and genotypes.
